signatures.description: Verifying a submit-path criterion (e.g. the submit response body) on a scratch instance fails in two ways before you find the working shape: --readonly returns 403 by design, and --skip-sandbox makes /health ok but POST /api/v1/problems/submit return 400 solver_unavailable ("solver is not available (bwrap + pi-agent not configured)") because main.go sets SolverAvailable = solverExec != nil and passes --skip-sandbox into the sandbox constructor. Working recipe: run the scratch WITHOUT --skip-sandbox with a harmless stand-in solver (--pi-agent /bin/true --bwrap /usr/bin/bwrap) and --cron-interval 24h so the startup tick logs "cron: system is not idle" and never dequeues, against a sqlite3 .backup copy of the live DB. Then build the same binary from the parent commit into a second scratch port and compare both submit responses side by side: pre/post on byte-copies of the production DB is the strongest non-destructive proof of a response-shape change.
